<script type="text/javascript" id="d_track_campaign" data-entry-referrer>
    (function() {
        if (!window.location.search) {
            return;
        }
        const cleanParams = window.location.search.substring(1); // Strip ?
        const queryParams = cleanParams.split('&');

        const expires = 'expires=' + new Date().getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        const domain = 'domain=' + window.location.hostname;
        const path = "path=/";

        queryParams.forEach((param) => {
            const [key, value = ''] = param.split('=');
            if (key.startsWith('utm_')) {
                const cookieName = "_dm_rt_" + key.substring(4);
                const cookie = cookieName + "=" + value;
                const joined = [cookie, expires, domain, path].join(";");
                document.cookie = joined;
            }
        });
    }());
</script>

        _dm_insite.forEach((rule) => {
            _dm_gaq.pushEvent(id, 'insite_impression', 'insite', rule.ruleType + '__' + rule.ruleId);

        const eventProps = {

        };
        gtag('event', event, eventProps);
    }

<script>
    function toHash(str) {
        var hash = 5381, i = str.length;
        while (i) {
            hash = hash * 33 ^ str.charCodeAt(--i)
        }
        return hash >>> 0
    }
</script>
<script>
    (function (global) {
    //const cacheKey = global.cacheKey;
    const isOffline = 'onLine' in navigator && navigator.onLine === false;
    const hasServiceWorkerSupport = 'serviceWorker' in navigator;
    if (isOffline) {
        console.log('offline mode');
    }
    if (!hasServiceWorkerSupport) {
        console.log('service worker is not supported');
    }
    if (hasServiceWorkerSupport && !isOffline) {
        window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            const serviceWorkerPath = '/runtime-service-worker.js?v=3';
            navigator.serviceWorker
                .register(serviceWorkerPath, { scope: './' })
                .then(
                    function (registration) {
                        // Registration was successful
                        console.log(
                            'ServiceWorker registration successful with scope: ',
                            registration.scope
                        );
                    },
                    function (err) {
                        // registration failed :(
                        console.log('ServiceWorker registration failed: ', err);
                    }
                )
                .catch(function (err) {
                    console.log(err);
                });
        });

        // helper function to refresh the page
        var refreshPage = (function () {
            var refreshing;
            return function () {
                if (refreshing) return;
                // prevent multiple refreshes
                var refreshkey = 'refreshed' + location.href;
                var prevRefresh = localStorage.getItem(refreshkey);
                if (prevRefresh) {
                    localStorage.removeItem(refreshkey);
                    if (Date.now() - prevRefresh < 30000) {
                        return; // dont go into a refresh loop
                    }
                }
                refreshing = true;
                localStorage.setItem(refreshkey, Date.now());
                console.log('refereshing page');
                window.location.reload();
            };
        })();

        function messageServiceWorker(data) {
            return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
                if (navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
                    var worker = navigator.serviceWorker.controller;
                    var messageChannel = new MessageChannel();
                    messageChannel.port1.onmessage = replyHandler;
                    worker.postMessage(data, [messageChannel.port2]);
                    function replyHandler(event) {
                        resolve(event.data);
                    }
                } else {
                    resolve();
                }
            });
        }
    }
})(window);
</script>

<script id='d-js-dmapi'>
    window.SystemID = 'US_DIRECT_PRODUCTION';

    if (!window.dmAPI) {
        window.dmAPI = {
            registerExternalRuntimeComponent: function () {
            },
            getCurrentDeviceType: function () {
                return window._currentDevice;
            },
            runOnReady: (ns, fn) => {
                const safeFn = dmAPI.toSafeFn(fn);
                ns = ns || 'global_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 11);
                const eventName = 'afterAjax.' + ns;

                if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
                    $.DM.events.off(eventName).on(eventName, safeFn);
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        safeFn({
                            isAjax: false,
                        });
                    }, 0);
                } else {
                    window?.waitForDeferred?.('dmAjax', () => {
                        $.DM.events.off(eventName).on(eventName, safeFn);
                        safeFn({
                            isAjax: false,
                        });
                    });
                }
            },
            toSafeFn: (fn) => {
                if (fn?.safe) {
                    return fn;
                }
                const safeFn = function (...args) {
                    try {
                        return fn?.apply(null, args);
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.log('function failed ' + e.message);
                    }
                };
                safeFn.safe = true;
                return safeFn;
            }
        };
    }

    if (!window.requestIdleCallback) {
        window.requestIdleCallback = function (fn) {
            setTimeout(fn, 0);
        }
    }
</script>












<script data-role="deferred-init" type="text/javascript">
    /* usage: window.getDeferred(<deferred name>).resolve() or window.getDeferred(<deferred name>).promise.then(...)*/
    function Def() {
        this.promise = new Promise((function (a, b) {
            this.resolve = a, this.reject = b
        }).bind(this))
    }

    const defs = {};
    window.getDeferred = function (a) {
        return null == defs[a] && (defs[a] = new Def), defs[a]
    }
    window.waitForDeferred = function (b, a, c) {
        let d = window?.getDeferred?.(b);
        d
            ? d.promise.then(a)
            : c && ["complete", "interactive"].includes(document.readyState)
                ? setTimeout(a, 1)
                : c
                    ? document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", a)
                    : console.error(`Deferred  does not exist`);
    };
</script>

<script>
    window.customWidgetsFunctions["5bd886efb15a44fd98f083f461519ec8~232"] = function (element, data, api) {
        
$(element).find('a').each(function() {
    var href = buildNewHref(cleanPhoneText(data.config.waNumber), cleanAndEncodeText(data.config.defaultMessage));
    $(this).attr('href', href);
    
    function handleClick(){
        dm_gaq_push_event && dm_gaq_push_event('Whatsapp', 'click')
        window.dmsnowplow && window.snowplow('trackStructEvent', 'Whatsapp-share','click')
    }
    
    element.addEventListener("click", handleClick)

})

function cleanPhoneText(phone) {
    return phone ? phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') : "";
}

function cleanAndEncodeText(text) {
    var returnString="";
    if (text) {
        returnString = text.replace(/<br>/g, '\n');
        returnString = encodeURIComponent(returnString);
    }
    return returnString;
}

function buildNewHref (phone, text) {
    return "https://wa.me/" + ( phone ? ( phone + '?' ) : '?' ) + "text=" + text;
}

    };
</script>

 <div class="u_1264408814 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" id="1264408814" data-version="5" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="m-text-align-center"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Poppins, 'Poppins Fallback';">The wooden chalets at Pousada Vila Guar&aacute; in Atins are a perfect combination of comfort and nature. Built with safe materials and respecting the local aesthetics, the chalets offer a cozy and rustic environment, ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring the region's natural beauty. Their architecture was designed with the aim of taking advantage of the region's winds, with cross ventilation that provides great comfort for guests.</span> 
</p><p class="m-text-align-center"><br/></p><p class="m-text-align-center"> <span style="display:initial;font-family:Poppins, 'Poppins Fallback';">﻿With stunning views of the dunes and native vegetation, each chalet provides a unique experience, connecting guests with the tranquility of the place. The inn is known for its friendly service and family atmosphere, making a stay even more special for those seeking a peaceful getaway in Maranh&atilde;o.</span>

 <div class="u_restaurant dmRespRow dmSectionParallaxNew" style="text-align: center;" id="restaurant" data-anchor="restaurant"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1165878400"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 medium-6 large-6 u_1024271086" id="1024271086"> <div class="u_1308928649 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1308928649" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out 0s; text-align: left;"><p class="text-align-left m-text-align-center"> <span style="color:var(--color_1);display:initial;">GASTRONOMY</span> 
</p></div> 
 <div class="u_1797731009 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" id="1797731009" style="transition: none; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h3 class="text-align-left m-text-align-center size-36 m-size-25" style="letter-spacing: 0.1em;"> <span class="font-size-36 m-font-size-25" style="font-weight:normal;display:initial;">RESTAURANT</span> 
</h3> 
</div> <div class="u_1191931033 imageWidget align-center" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1191931033"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/2ebbda22/dms3rep/multi/opt/detalhe-logo-1920w.png" alt="" id="1064170827" class="" width="502" height="109" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/2ebbda22/dms3rep/multi/detalhe-logo.png" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1691630920 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" id="1691630920" data-version="5" style="transition: none; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="m-text-align-center"> <span style="display:initial;">With regional and creative cuisine, Restaurante Guar&aacute; seeks to promote a true connection with the Cai&ccedil;ara culture and gastronomy of Atins. Its dishes are prepared with fresh, local ingredients, respecting the traditions of the village and valuing the work of fishermen, farmers and, above all, the environment. The menu revives traditional recipes, creating gastronomic experiences that celebrate the authentic flavors of the region. Breakfast is served from 7:30 to 10:00, while the restaurant opens from 10:00 (check availability for dinner). The bar is open from 10:00 to 20:00, offering delicious options to accompany your day.</span> 
</p></div></div>

 <div class="u_1729304109 dmRespCol small-12 medium-6 large-6" id="1729304109"> <div class="u_1734872041 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" id="1734872041" style="transition: none; display: block; text-align: left;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h1 style="line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.1em;" class="m-text-align-center m-size-29 size-36"><span style="font-weight:300;display:initial;font-family:Poppins, 'Poppins Fallback';" class="font-size-36 m-font-size-29">KITESURFING</span></h1> 
</div> <div class="u_1666583055 imageWidget align-center" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1666583055"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/2ebbda22/dms3rep/multi/opt/detalhe-logo-1920w.png" alt="" id="1476712397" class="" width="502" height="109" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/2ebbda22/dms3rep/multi/detalhe-logo.png" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1159469915 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" id="1159469915" data-version="5" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="m-text-align-center size-16 m-size-15"> <span class="font-size-16 m-font-size-15" style="display:initial;">Located 600 km west of Fortaleza, Atins is a popular destination for kite surfers, and is the final stop for many legendary downwinders. Located in the Pregui&ccedil;as River Delta, the region is known for its winding river mouth, which forms sandbanks and shallow lagoons. With constant winds, Atins offers perfect conditions for the sport, especially between July and December, when the deserted beaches are bathed by winds of 15 to 30 knots. In addition, Vila Guar&aacute;, at the entrance to Len&ccedil;&oacute;is Maranhenses, provides a unique setting, with white sand dunes and underground water, making the experience even more unforgettable for kiters.</span> 
</p></div></div>

 <div class="u_1231030052 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle ql-disabled" id="1231030052" style="transition: none; display: block;" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5"> <h3 class="text-align-left m-text-align-center" style="letter-spacing: 0.1em;"> <span style="color:var(--color_5);font-weight:normal;display:initial;">ACTIVITIES</span> 
</h3> 
</div> <div class="u_1231299552 imageWidget align-center" data-element-type="image" data-widget-type="image" id="1231299552"><img src="https://irp.cdn-website.com/2ebbda22/dms3rep/multi/opt/detalhe-logo-1920w.png" alt="" id="1177770123" class="" width="502" height="109" data-dm-image-path="https://irp.cdn-website.com/2ebbda22/dms3rep/multi/detalhe-logo.png" onerror="handleImageLoadError(this)"/></div> 
 <div class="u_1748049942 dmNewParagraph ui-sortable-handle" id="1748049942" data-version="5" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="m-text-align-center"> <span style="display:initial;">In addition to being a paradise for kitesurfing, Vila Guar&aacute; offers a variety of activities to suit all tastes. Visitors can explore the Len&ccedil;&oacute;is Maranhenses National Park, with its imposing dunes and crystal-clear lagoons, or go stand-up paddleboarding in the region&rsquo;s calm waters. Cultural tours of Ponta do Mangue and Lagoa do M&aacute;rio reveal the rich local history, while the flight of scarlet ibises enchants with their natural beauty. For those seeking more adventure, a boat trip along the Pregui&ccedil;a River and a visit to the Baixa Grande oasis complete the experience, offering a unique immersion in the stunning scenery of Atins.</span> 
</p></div></div>

<script type="text/javascript" id="d_track_sp">
    ;(function(p,l,o,w,i,n,g){if(!p[i]){p.GlobalSnowplowNamespace=p.GlobalSnowplowNamespace||[];
        p.GlobalSnowplowNamespace.push(i);p[i]=function(){(p[i].q=p[i].q||[]).push(arguments)
        };p[i].q=p[i].q||[];n=l.createElement(o);g=l.getElementsByTagName(o)[0];n.async=1;
        n.src=w;g.parentNode.insertBefore(n,g)}}(window,document,"script","//d32hwlnfiv2gyn.cloudfront.net/sp-2.0.0-dm-0.1.min.js","snowplow"));
    window.dmsnowplow  = window.snowplow;

    dmsnowplow('newTracker', 'cf', 'd32hwlnfiv2gyn.cloudfront.net', { // Initialise a tracker
        appId: '2ebbda22'
    });

    // snowplow queries element styles so we wait until CSS calculations are done.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        dmsnowplow('trackPageView');
        _dm_insite.forEach((rule) => {
            // Specifically in popup only the client knows if it is shown or not so we don't always want to track its impression here
            // the tracking is in popup.js
            if (rule.actionName !== "popup") {
                dmsnowplow('trackStructEvent', 'insite', 'impression', rule.ruleType, rule.ruleId);
            }
            window?.waitForDeferred?.('dmAjax', () => {
                $.DM.events.trigger('event-ruleTriggered', {value: rule});
            });
        });
    });
